title: Patch embeddings, class token, and position embeddings
goal:
Write `embed_patches(img, P, E, x_class, E_pos)`, which computes $z_0$ from Equation 1 of the paper:

$$z_0 = [x_{\text{class}};\, x_p^1 E;\, x_p^2 E;\, \cdots;\, x_p^N E] + E_{pos}$$

`E` has shape `(P*P*C, D)`, `x_class` has shape `(D,)`, and `E_pos` has shape `(N + 1, D)`. The class token goes first, the position embeddings are added to every row (including the class row), and the projection has no bias. The result has shape `(N + 1, D)`.

The starter includes a finished `patchify` from exercise 1.
hints: `patchify(img, P) @ E` gives the `(N, D)` patch embeddings.
`np.vstack([x_class[None, :], proj])` puts the class token in row 0.
Add `E_pos` after you stack. The class token gets a position embedding too.
